title: Danny Hart PINS IT to Victory: Winning Run | UCI MTB World Cup 2016
description:
► Watch UCI MTB's Fastest Riders Compete on Red Bull TV: http://win.gs/UCI16SUI
Danny 'The Redcar Rocket' Hart won his first ever UCI DH World Cup in Lenzerheide by just 0.096s ahead of current World Cup overall leader Aaron Gwin. It's been a long time coming for the MS Mondraker rider after scoring his fair share of second placed finishes, but in an epic display of downhill mountain biking, Hart snuck past Gwin's time for an absolutely well deserved victory. Sit back and feast your eyes his winning run!
